mu_measure: flat mu prior; analytic common amplitude; no reference in prediction
reference_kernel: Gaussian modulus measurement kernel, sigma from frozen shared distance draws; same for all methods. Marginal predictive density is p convolved with kernel; not a joint cluster likelihood.
bootstrap: 256 shared member multinomial and common observed-distance parametric bootstrap; reference kernel retained in scores. No additional predictive broadening. V5 cohort reuses original multiplicity/scale and coupled M13-zero draws for legacy replay.

IMF.name: Kroupa2001
IMF.integral: continuous normalized piecewise M^-alpha dM_init over each actual subdivided monotonic initial-mass interval

decision.primary: M5 turnoff; then M30 and M13; fixed A-B/B-C/C-D/D-E; mixed if scales/scores/support disagree

examples.ranking: on frozen v5 cohort; most negative centered-minus-original QRF marginal score and closest-to-median ordinary change; representative sources nearest phase median A residual; DE largest absolute post-MS mass change, ties by native ID

CRPS: positive loss E|X-y|-0.5 E|X-Xprime| on modulus coordinate after same Gaussian reference convolution; evaluate full normalized distributions, including tails
frozen_sky: selected_channels main B5-10/G10-20/R20-100; all existing sky images unchanged
